say:0:1030301401:0.text: Look, magister! A trail of footprints... Where does it lead?
say:0:1030301401:0.source_cn: 看啊，主人！是一排脚印，那通向……通向哪里了？
say:0:1030301401:0.male: Look, magister! A trail of footprints... Where does it lead?
say:0:1030301401:0.female: Look, magister! A trail of footprints... Where does it lead?

say:1:1030301402:0.text: Into the water. Perhaps someone was running from those gruglins.
say:1:1030301402:0.source_cn: 通向水里，或许是为了躲避那群发疯的咕布林。
say:1:1030301402:0.male: Into the water. Perhaps someone was running from those gruglins.
say:1:1030301402:0.female: Into the water. Perhaps someone was running from those gruglins.
